microban.author: David W. Skinner
microban.distribution_terms: These sets may be freely distributed provided they remain properly credited.
microban.notes: Vendored verbatim from the ShenMian/sokoban-rs collection (assets/levels/microban_155.xsb), which preserves Skinner's original file. The only change is a prepended attribution header (XSB ';' comments, ignored by every parser) so the credit travels with the corpus.

pullban.author: William Coldren
pullban.distribution_terms: Freely distributable with attribution, on the same terms as the bundled Microban set.
pullban.attribution_required: Pullban (original) by William Coldren, for Sokopelago.
pullban.notes: An original Sokopelago expert corpus for the Phase 5 ability tier: a mix of ordinary push levels and levels that require the Pull ability. Designed by William Coldren (2026); levels 11+ are machine-authored for this project, every board solver-verified. Adopts Microban's distribution terms but is original work owing no Skinner attribution.

autoban.author: Sokopelago owned generator (tools/generate_corpus.py)
autoban.distribution_terms: Freely distributable with attribution, on the same terms as the bundled Microban set.
autoban.attribution_required: Autoban (generated) by the Sokopelago puzzle generator.
autoban.notes: Generated in-house by Sokopelago's own puzzle generator and original by construction: each level is built by reverse-construction (place every box on a goal, then scatter with legal pulls), so it contains no third-party puzzles and needs no external attribution. Difficulty is calibrated against Microban's native scale.
